designDetails.silhouette: Inherit the V66 Praetorian: broad swept-back shield and forward oval dome, heavy guardian chest, narrow waist, exactly two long main arms, two digitigrade legs and one complete spear-tail. It must remain distinct from the four-armed Queen.
designDetails.palette: Warm bone-ivory, pearl gray and pale beige chitin; restrained translucent blush/taupe at thin membranes and dome margins; cool gray recesses, dark mouth cavity, ivory teeth and moist highlights.
designDetails.surface: Keep biomechanical ribs, tendon channels, segmented shield and tail readable through value and material contrast. The albino surface is newly authored, never a white filter over base frames.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless shielded head, one ribbed torso, exactly two main arms, two digitigrade legs and one continuous articulated tail. No small chest arms, equipment or clothing.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 40 poses; shield, dome, hands, feet and full tail remain inside each cell without camera rotation.
designDetails.scale: Inherit the reviewed enemy-007 physical scale and rigid shield/thorax proportions. Never infer size from tail arc, crouch height or a single extreme pose.
designDetails.root: Inherit the base reviewed pelvis/proximal-leg registration and supporting-foot floor. Shield, tail and changing limb reach never redefine the root.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, scenery, hive resin, text or grid.
